fresh.name: Leash
fresh.desc: Enforceable spending mandates for AI shopping agents. Plain-language rules compiled into a signed policy, a PayPal Orders v2 authorization as the hard ceiling, per-cart rule checks, merchant-verified receipts and dispute evidence.

fresh.name: RuleDost
fresh.desc: Paste a hackathon's rules and get the real deadline in your time zone, whether you can enter, and what to submit, with every answer backed by the exact sentence from the rules. Fully offline.

fresh.name: dayrhythm
